coordination_holds: The 0.20 m nominal junction between GLZ-WS-A and the main hall glazing requires one coordinated mullion, trimmer, drainage and air/water-seal detail.
Dedicated secondary steel must carry workstation and bench loads; facade girts, window frames and primary members are not assumed adequate.
Glare, solar control, condensation, cold downdraught, privacy and opening configuration remain dependent on the selected site and facade orientation.
The project-car bench remains provisional until the lift, vehicle and tool-storage envelopes are verified with real product data.
